channel.title: Chain Times
channel.description: Chain Times reports crypto news: bitcoin and ether markets, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: When Does Staking TRX Beat Renting TRON Energy?
item.description: Staking can lower the per-transfer cost when TRON demand is steady, but rental often suits irregular use; compare energy needs, rental quotes and locked TRX.

item.title: Set a Slippage Limit Before a BNB Chain Swap
item.description: A wallet’s slippage setting caps how far a BNB Chain swap may move from its quote; set it to limit price drift while avoiding failed trades and poor fills.

item.title: Why Polygon Bridge withdrawals wait at a checkpoint
item.description: A Polygon PoS withdrawal can wait at a checkpoint before Ethereum releases the tokens; check whether the burn is recorded or a claim is still due.

item.title: SEC proposes crypto custody rules for advisers and funds
item.description: The SEC proposed custody rules that could let advisers and funds hold some crypto themselves or use state trust companies, changing how regulated investors access tokens.

item.title: How a treasury can move funds with manta bridge
item.description: A treasury transfer to Manta Pacific starts with asset approval and a bridge deposit; plan for Ethereum fees, confirmation time and internal controls.

item.title: CSD BR starts mirroring fund shares on XRP Ledger
item.description: CSD BR is mirroring selected BTG Pactual fund shares on XRP Ledger, adding a second ownership record while its database remains Brazil's official record.
